title: Withdrawal of license.
officialText:
If a licensed master plumber withdraws from a master plumbing business operating pursuant
to such individual’s license, the right of the business to perform plumbing work shall lapse if the provisions of this section 28-
408.6 are no longer satisfied. If a licensed master plumber’s license is revoked or suspended, such licensee will be deemed
withdrawn from such business.
